question: Music students who began lessons at age 4 or 5 were tested for perfect pitch. Where was it far more common?
options: At a conservatory in New York State
answer: Beijing. Diana Deutsch's team found that about 60% of early starters at Beijing's Central Conservatory had perfect pitch, against about 14% at Eastman in New York State. Speakers of Mandarin, a tone language, learn from infancy that pitch changes meaning. A rare gift in one sample is a common skill in another.
move: A trait called rare may only be rare where it was counted.
ask: Which ability do I think I simply lack, when I may never have had the right early practice?
trap: Treating perfect pitch as a rare inborn gift, the same everywhere.
reference: Deutsch, Henthorn, Marvin & Xu, Absolute pitch among American and Chinese conservatory students, Journal of the Acoustical Society of America, 2006
